title: Pony experiences, home-ed club and creative arts near Bath
description: Creative Rein brings together horses, ponies, the outdoors and creative arts in Bathford, five minutes from Bath. Experiences and wellbeing for all ages, Home-Ed Club, Little Rein Club, events and pony parties.

sections.heading: A calm place to learn, play and reconnect
sections.lede: A countryside haven above Bath, with horses, ponies and space to breathe. Come on your own, with friends or with the whole family. No horse experience needed.

sections.heading: Horses, the outdoors and creative arts
sections.body:
Creative Rein is a place near Bath where everyone can spend time with horses and ponies, get outdoors and be creative.

We bring together horses, outdoor exploration and creative practice in a setting where everyone can discover and pursue different interests and ways of learning.

Everyone is welcome: children of all ages, families, grown-ups on their own, friends and groups. We keep groups small, so everyone can go at their own pace.

sections.heading: Experiences & Wellbeing
sections.body:
Quiet connection beside our ponies and horses, mindful grooming, wonderful walks through gentle rolling hills and woodland paths, and time to draw, paint, build or simply be.

Whatever your age, come and spend some time with us.

image.alt: A black pony lying down in the paddock, with Bathford and the valley behind

sections.heading: Home Education
sections.body:
Creative Rein offers term-time learning to enrich your child's journey in life. Our weekly Home-Ed Club combines creative arts, equine activities and outdoor learning. It's a place to develop, build experience and socialise.

Each session has its own theme, with activities adapted to suit different ages and interests. Our small-group approach allows for a more personal experience, with time to explore individual interests as well as enjoying the social side of being part of an engaging group.

No previous horse experience is needed and riding is entirely optional. It's simply about being you.

image.alt: The wooden art room, with a long table, chairs and paintings pegged along the wall

sections.heading: Little Rein Club
sections.body:
We want your child to feel safe and confident around horses: comfortable touching them, interacting with them, or simply being in their presence.

Our gentle early years sessions bring together pony time, outdoor adventures, crafts and learning through play.
